phoneNumber.description: Phone number used if selection is `FORWARD_TO_SPECIFIED_NUMBER`.

selection.description:
Controls what happens when the rule matches.
 * `FORWARD_TO_DEFAULT_NUMBER` - When the rule matches, forward to the destination for the auto attendant.
 * `FORWARD_TO_SPECIFIED_NUMBER` - When the rule matches, forward to the destination for this rule.
 * `DO_NOT_FORWARD` - When the rule matches, do not forward to another number.
